scores.evidence: Each of the 3 can-do objectives has 2 or more graded questions, and each has one at apply level or higher (o1: q4 apply, e1 analyze, e2 apply; o2: q2, q3, e3 evaluate; o3: q5, e6 apply). One gap remains: o1 lists 「CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール」, but its exam items test a hook (e2, answer 「フックで自動的に実行させる」) and when AGENTS.md is read (e1). Only q4 tests a choice among the places o1 names.

hook-b1 sets a concrete scenario in 3 sentences: the repeated test-command explanation and the senior's 300-line CLAUDE.md with 「`.env` は絶対に読まない」. Its promise now matches the prediction (「まず、`.env` の読み取りをどう止めるか、予想してみましょう」). q0 is an ungraded predict item tied to o3, and its explanation points ahead to 6-4.

Prerequisites list 第1回–第5回 by title, and the lesson recalls them where they are needed (「第1回と第5回で見たとおり」 in s1-lead, 「第2回で書いた、ツールの使用を…」 in s4-defs). Terms are defined before use with English on first use (セッション（session）, 権限ルール（permission rule）, フック（hook）). The changed glossary AGENTS.md entry now agrees with s3-defs and card-agents (「既定では、作業フォルダーとその上に…」, 「`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` は数えません」).

measure.mjs: 「prose 2399 (budget 1,200–2,400) · questions 9 · est 19.3 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」. The lesson is within budget, estMinutes matches, and lint --strict reports 0 warnings. Two things keep this from a 4. s3 still packs 3 new terms, a code block, a diagram, a callout and a check into one segment. And 自動メモリ（auto memory） is defined in s1-defs, but no later block or question uses it, so it adds load without any later use.

s5-steps is a complete worked example placed before practice. It has 6 subgoal-labelled steps (「① コードからわかる行を消す」…「⑥ 自分だけの好みをローカルへ移す」), each with a reason in md and a result in expect (「チームのCLAUDE.mdは2行になります」). There is no faded example between it and the independent 19-line practice.

s1–s4 each end with an inline check, and every wrong option has feedback. q2 asks the learner to repair a conflict, q3 to judge which line can go, and q4 to place a 10-line rule set. q5 is still answerable by recognition: its answer 「CLAUDE.mdは判断の材料として読まれ、強制はされないから」 restates s4-lead 「参考に判断しますが、必ず守るという保証はありません」, which the learner has just read.

Every misconception in the brief appears as a distractor, with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer: override vs concatenation (q2 b, e1 a), `@` reducing context (q4 c, e3 a), long is better or the 200-line limit as a guarantee (q5 b, e6 b), 「覚えている」 (e6 a), and auto mode (e6 d). The 「IMPORTANT」 option is still a wrong answer in 5 of the 9 items (q0 a, q2 a, q5 a, e2 a, e3 c), and in both exam items where it appears, so a learner can eliminate it by pattern.

s3-diagram is exemplary: 5 nodes, labels in the text's own terms, and a caption that states the takeaway (「減らせるのは paths: 付きのルールです」). The changed s1-table, however, has labels that clash with its caption 「（広い順）」. 「どこでも」 comes after 「組織全体」 but sounds broader, and 「ここだけ」 vs 「チーム」 mixes where with who, so column 1 alone does not show the order.

The task is authentic and asks for near transfer: a 19-line file, with 「整形→フック候補」 and the combined test lines as new cases. It has a 3-level hint ladder (pr-decide hint, troubleshoot, practice-hint3), a 7-item checklist and a model answer. hint3 now matches the answer (「「ちゃんと」の行は…に直し、残りのテスト2行は1つにまとめます」), and practice-answer's highlight 6–12 covers exactly the 4 kept items and the comment that practice-answer-why describes.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question (「ここ1週間で、Claudeに2回以上した同じ説明や直しはありますか」) and names the next lesson by its title. summary-cards has 7 cards, and summary-ask offers 3 tutor prompts.

All five findings in audit-cc-06-claude-md.json are fixed in the current text. The default qualifier is in s3-defs, the glossary and card-agents (「既定では、作業フォルダーとその上に…」), and the single-file condition is in q4 and card-paths (「1つのファイルを `cat` や `head` で見たときも」). The limits of deny rules match cross-lesson-facts.md items 3–4 (s4-close 「`git -C . push`」), the version is pinned (「Claude Code v2.1.304」), and the practice-answer `sed -n '/^## 画面/,$p'` range copies the heading and its 6 steps.

Learner text keeps です・ます and a warm tone (「まず…予想してみましょう」, 「迷ったら…確かめましょう」). The plain-form lines in practice-setup and the casual replies in e6 are intended voices (a sample file and a colleague). lint --strict finds no banned phrase or long sentence. Wording is left to ja-editor.
The jp locale is complete, including the Japanese diagram labels. s3-diagram's alt describes exactly what is drawn, and its caption is present. The link text says where it goes (「公式ドキュメント（日本語）」).

niceToHave: s1-table (changed): the caption says 「（広い順）」, but 「どこでも」 comes after 「組織全体」 and reads as broader. The order shown is the load order (broad to specific in the memory docs). Replace the caption with 「CLAUDE.mdの4つの置き場所と届く範囲（読まれる順）」 (same length), or replace row 2 col 1 with 「自分全般」 (ja-editor to confirm the wording).

check-quiz e6 option a (changed): the lesson teaches auto memory in s1-defs, so the feedback 「セッションは毎回まっさらに始まり、前の会話は引き継がれません。」 leaves out the case where Claude did save the rule. A learner may think it was remembered after all. The option also fits the scenario poorly, because the colleague wrote the rule in CLAUDE.md, not in a chat. Replace md with 「「Claudeが自動メモリにも書いたから、もう確実だよ」」 and feedback with 「自動メモリもCLAUDE.mdと同じく、読まれる頼みごとです。止めたい操作は、拒否ルールやフックで決めておきます。」. This also gives 自動メモリ（s1-defs） a use (see load). Check the result against the 2,400 cap with measure.mjs.

check-quiz e2 option a (unchanged): 「IMPORTANT」 is still the wrong answer in 5 items. Replace e2 a md with 「CLAUDE.mdに「編集したら必ず整形する」と書く」 and keep its feedback (「Claudeが整形を選んで実行するのと、整形が自動で走るのは別のことです。…」), which already names this exact misconception.
s4-check q5 option c (unchanged): to stop recognition matching with s4-lead, replace the answer md with 「CLAUDE.mdの行は、Claude Codeが操作を止める設定ではないから」.

objectives o1 (unchanged): e2 assesses choosing a hook, which o1 does not list. Change o1 text to 「指示の置き場所（CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール・フック）を、内容に合わせて選べる」. Changing objectives forces a full review next round.

s4-table (unchanged): 「禁止」 and 「API専用」 follow the blog's anti-pattern names. pr-explain and summary-next send learners to this table to sort their own lines, so a broader label would transfer better. Consider 「一部のファイル用」 for row 4 col 1 and offset the characters in the caption.
Budget guard: prose is 2399 of the 2,400 cap (measure.mjs). Offset any text a fix adds with an equal cut.
summary: Full review of the current text. Every criterion scores 3 or more (mean 3.46), and there are no must-fix items. validate and lint --strict are clean, and measure.mjs gives 19.3 min with prose at 2399/2400. The biggest strengths are the 6-step worked example followed by a consistent 19-line practice with a 3-level hint ladder, the model answer and the checklist, plus accuracy: every audit finding is fixed. The most useful next fixes are to remove the 「IMPORTANT」 elimination pattern (still a wrong answer in 5 items, including e2 a) and to make the changed s1-table labels agree with 「（広い順）」.
